title: The Two Substances and the Work of Separation
description: The foundational dualism stated in concentrated form: two substances exist from the beginning — Light and Darkness, the beautiful and the bitter, life and death — three correspondential pairs naming the same opposition through understanding, affection, and life itself. The redemptive operation is given as one verb: separating the beautiful one forth from the Darkness (ⲡⲱⲣⲭ). The book here returns to its starting principle, now stated as the very work of regeneration.
